h1.soc_gap_at_launch: Triple therapy leaves symptomatic patients with residual breathlessness; no approved agent combines bronchodilation and anti-inflammatory action without oral PDE4 GI toxicity.
minimum_specs: FEV1 AUC0-12h improvement >=100 mL vs placebo on top of LAMA
GI AE rate within 5% of placebo
must_haves: >=100 mL FEV1 improvement on top of LAMA
GI adverse-event rate within 5% of placebo
h1.expansion_opportunity: Non-CF bronchiectasis and asthma via the same dual mechanism

claims.text: Oral PDE4 GI intolerance limits use

h2.soc_gap_at_launch: At launch, eosinophilic exacerbators on triple therapy still exacerbate; anti-IL5 failed, so no approved biologic is expected for this segment.
minimum_specs: >=25% reduction in moderate/severe exacerbations vs placebo on top of triple therapy in eos>=300
holy_grail_specs: >=40% exacerbation reduction plus >=100 mL FEV1 gain
dosing every 4 weeks or less often
must_haves: >=25% reduction in annualised moderate/severe exacerbations on triple therapy, eos>=300
h2.expansion_opportunity: Asthma-COPD overlap and chronic rhinosinusitis comorbidity

claims.text: Phase 3 in eos>=300 on triple therapy

h3.soc_gap_at_launch: Former smokers with low eosinophils have no targeted biologic; type 2 agents will not cover them.
minimum_specs: >=20% reduction in exacerbations in former smokers
must_haves: >=20% reduction in annualised exacerbations in patients with eos<300 cells/uL

h4.soc_gap_at_launch: No biologic covers both type 2 and non-type 2 COPD at launch.
minimum_specs: >=20% exacerbation reduction regardless of eosinophil count
must_haves: >=20% reduction in annualised exacerbations independent of eosinophil count

claims.text: Anti-TSLP asthma effect independent of eosinophils

h5.soc_gap_at_launch: Eosinophilic COPD remains uncovered after anti-IL5 failures.
must_haves: >=20% reduction in annualised exacerbations in eos>=300 on triple therapy
